reason: The source shows a depth guard for object printing, and the old harness prints only parser results. The supplied build script delegates configuration to an unsupplied script, so the effective nesting limit—and rejection specifically at depth 1000—cannot be established.

scope_contract.reason: The target's print operations take cJSON object trees. The source supports constructing and printing such trees.

evidence.dependency_reason: Creates object nodes that the print API can accept.

feasible_trigger.reason: A chain of 1001 objects can be constructed, but the guard rejects its deepest object at depth 1000 only if the effective CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT is 1000. The supplied build script delegates to an unsupplied recipe.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the supplied definition of the limit, but does not establish the effective build configuration.
Attaches named child objects without a depth check.
Delegates the build to fuzzing/ossfuzz.sh, whose contents were not supplied.

observable_consequence.reason: At the effective nesting limit, print_object returns false and the print calls return NULL. Whether that occurs at the frozen depth of 1000 depends on the missing configuration.

evidence.dependency_reason: Propagates a failed print_value call to the print failure path.
Buffered printing returns NULL when print_value fails.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: All three print choices receive only the parsed tree. Parsing checks the same nesting limit before admitting an object, and the optional minify call operates later on a byte copy.

identity_preserved.reason: The assessment consistently concerns rejection of a 1001-object chain when print_object enters at depth 1000; it does not substitute rejection at another configured depth.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The parser checks the nesting limit before accepting another object.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Identifies the delegated build recipe needed to resolve configuration.

missing_information: Supply numbered fuzzing/ossfuzz.sh and any build configuration it delegates to that can define CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
Supply numbered cJSON.h lines 136–138 to establish the condition on its displayed definition.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: With an effective limit of 1000, printing a constructed chain of 1001 nested objects returns NULL when the deepest object reaches print depth 1000.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Construct 1001 nested cJSON objects with named children and pass the root to a print operation under that configuration.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The entry obtains its sole print argument from cJSON_ParseWithOpts.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: The parser rejects the 1001st container at the same configured limit, so the target cannot print that constructed tree.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: The three print variants share the parsed argument; flags, trailing input, and the later minify call provide no tree construction route.
